test_title: PYST 22: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

Was the book written by an unknown author?

options.text: Did the book write an unknown author?
Was the book not written by an unknown author?
Was the unknown author reading the book?
Did an unknown author write the book?

solution:
The correct answer is: **Did an unknown author write the book?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **subject** of the **Passive Voice** is changed into the **object **of the **Active Voice**. Also, the **object** of the Passive Voice is changed into the **subject** of the **Active Voice**.
